description:
The '''Commander''' is an advanced support [[Towers|tower]] that decreases the firerate of towers within its range, increasing their damage output. It can be purchased in the store for {{Coins|4,000}}.

The '''Commander''' provides a 10% firerate boost to towers in its range, making them attack enemies faster. This buff can be boosted further at Level 2+ through the ''Call to Arms'' ability, which increases it by 10% for ten seconds. Both buffs get higher with levels, with the passive buff getting increased to 20% and the ''Call to Arms'' ability buff getting increased to 20%. It also has a second ability, ''Support Caravan'', which costs {{Money|2,000}} to use. This will summon two [[Gunner APC]]s and one [[Missile APC]] on the map. When any ability used, it will enter fury mode, allowing it to attack any enemy in its range for ten seconds. The attack time from using an ability stacks if multiple are used at once or when an ability is used while it is attacking. When an ability is used while fury mode is active, the timer for it will stop until the ability animation is finished.

The '''Commander''' is the primary [[Narrators|narrator]] in most matches. Text dialogue appears beside the image or the model with an idle animation of the '''Commander''', corresponding to the appearance of certain [[waves]]. This dialogue appears regardless of whether a '''Commander''' tower is present on the map, and the image or model of the '''Commander''' next to the dialogue will display different emotions.

The '''Commander''' has a placement limit of six per player.
